integrity: Proof uses a unit-circle determinant identity and exact geometric-series sums. The attached checker independently enumerates every 3-by-3 minor at orders 8 and 16 over integer cyclotomic arithmetic and checks closed formulas at additional powers of two. Finite checks are not a substitute for the all-order proof.
limitations: Only 3-by-3 minors of cyclic 2-power Fourier transforms are treated; no higher-minor or conditioning classification. Strongest residual originality risk is an inaccessible 2008 full-text treatment of prime-power rank-deficient Fourier submatrices. Independent validation is not available.
title: Complete third-order Fourier-minor rank incidence on dyadic cycles
